---
title: "Overview"
format:
  dashboard:
    css: styles.css
---

```{r}
#| include: false
world <- metawoRld::load_metawoRld(".", verbose = FALSE)
cfg <- metawoRld::read_config(".")
results <- if (requireNamespace("metafor", quietly = TRUE)) metawoRld::run_all_meta_analyses(".", world) else list()
sof <- metawoRld::summary_of_findings(results)
n_dp <- nrow(world$studies_data)
n_ver <- sum(world$studies_data$verification_status == "verified")
years <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(world$studies$year))
```

## Row {height=24%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Studies included"
list(icon = "journal-text", color = "primary", value = nrow(world$studies))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Data points"
list(icon = "table", color = "secondary", value = format(n_dp, big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Values verified"
list(icon = "patch-check", color = if (n_dp && n_ver / n_dp >= 0.9) "success" else "warning",
     value = if (n_dp) paste0(round(100 * n_ver / n_dp), "%") else "-")
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Last updated"
list(icon = "calendar-event", color = "light", value = format(Sys.Date(), "%b %Y"))
```

## Row {height=47%}

### Column {width=62%}

```{r}
#| title: "Summary of findings"
if (nrow(sof)) {
  tab <- sof[, c("analysis", "measure", "studies", "participants", "estimate", "I2", "prediction_interval")]
  names(tab) <- c("Meta-analysis", "Measure", "Studies", "Participants", "Pooled estimate [95% CI]", "I&sup2;", "Prediction interval")
  knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = "class='table table-sm'")
} else {
  cat("No meta-analyses defined yet. Add them to _analyses.yml.")
}
```

### Column {width=38%}

```{r}
#| title: "Studies by publication year"
if (any(!is.na(years))) {
  tab <- table(years)
  yr <- as.integer(names(tab))
  par(mar = c(2.5, 2.5, 0.5, 0.5), cex = 1.1, cex.axis = 1.3)
  plot(yr, as.integer(tab), type = "h", lwd = 14, lend = 1, col = "steelblue", axes = FALSE,
       xlab = "", ylab = "", ylim = c(0, max(tab)), xlim = range(yr) + c(-1, 1))
  axis(1, at = pretty(range(yr) + c(-1, 1)), col = "grey60")
  axis(2, at = seq(0, max(tab)), las = 1, col = "grey60")
}
```

## Row {height=35%}

```{r}
#| title: "About this review"
#| output: asis
cat(cfg$project_description, "\n\n")
cat("**Inclusion criteria**\n\n", paste0("- ", cfg$inclusion_criteria, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
cat("**Exclusion criteria**\n\n", paste0("- ", cfg$exclusion_criteria, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Study designs"
if (nrow(world$studies) && "study_design" %in% names(world$studies)) {
  tab <- sort(table(world$studies$study_design), decreasing = TRUE)
  knitr::kable(data.frame(Design = names(tab), Studies = as.integer(tab)), format = "html", table.attr = "class='table table-sm'")
}
```
